create_aggregate_context: create a named aggregation context to collect and aggregate metrics during training or validation loops
log_scalar_values: log a scalar metric value with optional weight and priority into all active aggregators
log_derived_metrics: log a derived metric computed from other meters using a callable function
log_timing_metrics: log the start and stop time of an event to measure duration in seconds
get_smoothed_values: get all smoothed metric values aggregated under a given named aggregator context
